title: ForceCloseResult
description: Synchronous return value of PositionWorkflow.force_close Update (WaitPolicy=Accepted). exit_signal_id is the dedupe key inside the workflow's exit machinery; api-gateway returns it in the 202 response so the operator can correlate the eventual fill.

status.description: ACCEPTED: cancel-then-marketable-sell sequence queued. NOOP_ALREADY_CLOSED: position already at remainingQty=0 (e.g. another exit just filled).
